decisions.sourceBehavior: 11 editable values; F_PopAmpBase10 not editable. Save/Load are Core.options array, not world files. Changing UPDATE_FREQUENCY changes deposit factor but existing repeated timer retains registered delay.
decisions.disposition: Persist active world settings and captured callback interval separately; keep scale/cadence distinction. Local settings preset save/load requires explicit Apply; no accidental world replacement or timer restart. A future cadence-reschedule change requires its own decision.
decisions.acceptance: Change frequency before/after registration, deposits before next callback, pure Load/Cancel and preset vs canonical save.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Active legacy fixed/height paths build timed owned sites without explicit price spend; completion creates owner. Automated plans create unowned structures/land. Construction has decorative-ground branches and weekday-holiday work.
decisions.disposition: Book by actual caller only; no universal upfront charge or zero receipt for no call. Retain source state gates/delays and P1 executing-entry cancellation; detach abandoned callbacks safely and never complete removed site.
decisions.acceptance: Four-stage fixture, full multi-floor gate table, no-booking vs zero, removal cancellation and source completion order.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Direct legacy menu entries commented; generic fixed builder rejects when canBeBuilt true and builds when false; variable builder/remover throw.
decisions.disposition: Use already-reviewed direct-catalog browser adaptation with positive source legality and atomic complete footprint validation; preserve original inverted/throwing paths in evidence, do not port a crash or count source picker availability as playable construction.
decisions.acceptance: Legal empty/flat and illegal occupied/bounds placements, generated null cannot construct, every direct family selectable.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Land wrapper spends area; rice and vinyl-house overrides add per-success spend; forest ownership assignment differs by caller; fence side overload bypasses area booking.
decisions.disposition: Retain caller-specific double/area/no-booking and actual owned assignments; no presumed forest evolution or farm population from names. Derive exact constructor/field behavior in P7-02/16..20.
decisions.acceptance: Same rectangle and skipped cells through each entry, rice double charge, fence side vs perimeter, unchanged preview RNG.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Commercial market valuation uses += on each update; var-height entityValue remains height*price; half owned=true with combined market valuation.
decisions.disposition: Preserve source value formulas, ownership distinctions and required repricing state/time in P7; no assignment correction or constant-price bridge to P8. P8 retains listing/trading/events/reports; valuation-only prerequisite is explicit.
decisions.acceptance: Two consecutive market updates, center land sampling, profit curve branches, entity dedup and deterministic temporal continuation.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Creation-order/fifth reverse membership asymmetry; demand outgoing vs residents/incoming; rice listener lifecycle; station land deposits and transport events distinct.
decisions.disposition: Consume P6 handoff without graph repair; attach real producer on source completion, detach on removal. Apply land intents inside detached minute once. No active bundled GlobalTrafficMonitor subscriber; preserve event interface without fabricated city traffic model.
decisions.acceptance: SCN-D01; actual producers before/after station, fifth links saved both ways, board/unload once and failure rollback.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Three bundled road definitions, zero roadAccessory/DummyCar instances; factories/menus exist. Bus is drawing stub, old dummy controller is uncompiled.
decisions.disposition: Exact three-road denominator; preserve extension API/empty catalog disposition and optional ownership. MAN-O04 six labels and DEV-D06 proposals add no bundled art, slope simulation or buses.
decisions.acceptance: All three styles/masks/crossings, empty selectors, optional provenance and no live bus claim.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Stadium event-driven mutable population/special listener, bookings and many callbacks cannot be represented by an ordinary constant building.
decisions.disposition: P7 producer-kind/lifecycle interface; P8 entire playable stadium/game/market/report event work. Keep two declarations and all stadium controls assigned to P8, not counted as completed P7 structures.
decisions.acceptance: No fixture population rebranding; P8 game attendance/season/calendar plus special listener continuation.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: HVStructure constructor creates one listener from initial half; add/remove(side) changes halves without rebuilding listener or market valuation, and second-half add has no spend.
decisions.disposition: Preserve initial listener population on compatible add/partial removal; whole-owner removal detaches. Do not sum both populations or charge second half without a separately accepted correction. Keep paired art/structurePrice separate from listener snapshot.
decisions.acceptance: Both creation orders with different provider definitions, second-half add/partial remove, zero second debit, saved initial population reference and whole-owner cleanup.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.

decisions.sourceBehavior: Reachable MultiSelectorController starts sites then spends fixed unitPrice or height*price. Legacy fixed/height controller paths have no explicit spend; bundled generic picker only has hidden zero-volume null child.
decisions.disposition: P7-12 direct-catalog adaptation must identify chosen caller contract: player catalog construction uses the reachable selector price/height booking and timed site, preserving no-booking legacy paths as source-only witnesses; automated plan remains unowned with no invented upfront spend.
decisions.acceptance: Fixed and variable quoted source selector price, no null-sentinel booking, rejected draft no selection randomization or spend; keep legacy no-debit tests labeled by caller.
decisions.authority: Pinned stable behavior; portable changes limited to existing session/random/preview safety and explicit direct-catalog plan adaptations.
